description.text: The MEGA Premium Trainer Box, released in Korean on 24 October 2025: ten packs each of Mega Brave and Mega Symphonia, 172 cards of 51 kinds (Pokémon, Trainers, Special Energy and basic Energy), a card box, a Pokémon coin (first print run only), acrylic damage counters, a damage counter case and premium Poison and Burn markers.
